structured_data.name: Advanced Rooting (Level 3 - Coming Soon)
structured_data.description:
Ready for hyper-realistic hair?
I've spent years refining my process, and this course will teach you a ton of secrets which took me years to learn through trial and error, saving you time and helping you take your rooting to the next level!
Let's begin my Advanced Rooting Course! (Level 2 → Level 3)
In this course you'll have access to 7 exclusive video tutorials created by me for you, spread over 7 weeks for you to study at your own pace.  The course is a combination of full-length video tutorials and quizzes.
These tutorials will include all the information you need to take your rooting from Intermediate (Level 2) to Advanced! (Level 3). 

If you are experienced but still developing your rooting technique, I would highley recommend taking Level 2 prior to the Level 3 to make sure you have the intermediate knowledge needed to get the most from Level 3! 
I've already purchased, let me in!

structured_data.description:
♥️ IN STOCK ♥️






I do ship worldwide, however you can find a dealer near you HERE


If you order directly from me, you will receive a special box opening experience, including a signed body and a personalised blanket lovey ♥️





"I’m am so excited to introduce you to little Christopher!! 



Little Christopher has been almost 6 years in the making!! But oh so worth the wait ❤️ His little pouty lips, and scrunchy little legs make him seem like he's just settling from a big stretch. He also has the perfect newborn scrunch when lifted. Completely melts my heart! 🥰
He has full limbs, and will be approx 19/20". I have created him a special custom body that gives him that perfect little belly that looks like it's full of milk. He will also have an optional belly plate that you can add to your pre-order
We should start seeing the prototype pictures late May, with the pre order not long after. Mark your calendar's so you don't miss out on this little cutie!!
I have fallen completely head over heels in love with him, and I hope you will too! 🥰
